question: Assume today is 2026-10-24. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total profits of China's industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额) for January-September 2026 (the cumulative total, not the single month of September), in Chinese yuan (CNY; the release states it in 亿元, i.e. units of 100 million yuan), as it will be first reported in the National Bureau of Statistics of China's monthly release on profits of industrial enterprises.

target.what: Cumulative total profits of industrial enterprises above designated size (规模以上工业企业利润总额) in mainland China for January-September 2026, as first reported by the National Bureau of Statistics of China in its monthly industrial profits release. This is the year-to-date cumulative total at current prices
target.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
target.cadence: Monthly, cumulative year-to-date; the first January-September 2026 industrial profits release is expected after 2026-10-24, around late October 2026
target.caveats: The target period is completed by the cutoff, but the first reported value is not yet published as of 2026-10-24. The estimate is for the first reported NBS figure, not later revised data. NBS reports the total in 亿元 at current prices. 'Above designated size' is a changing enterprise universe, so ye

candidates.hypothesis: The January-September cumulative figure is the January-August cumulative figure plus September monthly profit. January-August 2026 is likely published before the cutoff; September monthly can be anchored by the historical September increment as a share of January-August or by September 2025 monthly profit updated with current growth. This route directly constrains the level.
candidates.data_to_find: Exact NBS '利润总额' cumulative for January-August 2026 (亿元) and January-September 2025; monthly September profit totals for 2022-2025 if available; NBS notes on statistical scope and revisions. Minimum evidence: January-August 2026 cumulative and at least one historical September monthly/cumulative ratio. Substitute: January-July 2026 plus August and September increment estimates.
